name: ssg-voting-system
description: SSG election system: a dependency-free Node server plus a React front end that shows the roster, the ballot box and the audit chain reconciling.

scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build:client
scripts.build:api: cd api && npm install --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build
scripts.build:client: cd client && npm install --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build
